import narwhals as nw

def add_tier_column(df):
    df = nw.from_native(df)
    result = df.with_columns(
        nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000)
        .then(nw.lit("gold"))
        .otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
        .alias("tier")
    )
    return nw.to_native(result)
